t = df.index - pd.Timedelta(hours=1)
day = pd.Series(t.normalize(), index=df.index)
hod = pd.Series(t.hour, index=df.index)
inor = hod < 4
or_hi = df.high.where(inor).groupby(day).transform('max')
or_lo = df.low.where(inor).groupby(day).transform('min')
width = or_hi - or_lo
loc = (df.close - or_lo) / width - 0.5
dc = df.close.groupby(day).last()
prev = day.map(dc.pct_change().shift(1))
signal = pd.Series(np.sign(loc).replace(0, 1).fillna(1), index=df.index)
a = (hod == 3) & (width > 0) & (loc.abs() >= 0.3) & prev.notna() & (np.sign(prev) == signal)
b = (hod == 3) & (width > 0) & ~a
